name: sandboxing accepts literal injection text in intent (consumer-side defense required)
description: The literal string 'ignore prior instructions' is valid printable ASCII and the schema accepts it. Consumers MUST NOT interpolate intent into agent prompts; the structured-envelope rule per docs/THREAT_MODEL.md §5 is the binding control. This fixture exists to lock in the wire-level behavior so that consumer-side sandboxing is the authoritative test for this attack class.
notes: Pattern: literal-text injection. Defended at consumer layer, not at schema. Adapter conformance tests in Phase 2 and 5 verify the consumer-side defense; in Phase 1 the wire-level invariant is recorded here.
